question: How does the practitioner utter mantras and mudras at this stage of experience?
premises: The whole group of mantras and mudras is involved
The practitioner utters them in a disturbed manner
This utterance characterizes him at that stage
inference: At this stage he utters all the mantras and mudras in a stammering way.
